BiblicalUsage: ʼêl means these or those. In Genesis 19:8, the text says "only unto these men do nothing." In Leviticus 18:27, the text says "For all these abominations have the men of the land done."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ʼêl is a reminder that God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
